items.text: Among adults discharged after cardiac surgery at four centres from 2023 to 2026, how did 30-day readmission and 90-day health system cost change after two centres adopted remote monitoring in March 2025, compared with the change at centres that did not, and what is the cost per readmission avoided?
items.population: Adults discharged after cardiac surgery at four centres, 2023 to 2026
items.intervention: Discharge from a centre with remote monitoring after March 2025 (exposure)
items.comparator: Discharge from a centre with usual follow-up
items.outcome: 30-day readmission; 90-day health system cost; cost per readmission avoided

finer: Feasible with approved provincial data and three analysts; interesting to the ministry; novel as a real-world estimate with costs; ethical as secondary use without contact; relevant to the 2028 funding decision.
summary: One PECO question pairing effect and cost.
